name: substance use screening
remarks: Replaces src/main/resources/modules/encounter/substance_use_screening.json with a module that does nothing. Load it with -d config/common/modules.

The original runs AUDIT-C, DAST-10 and CRAFFT screenings at wellness encounters with United States positive rates and writes the findings Unhealthy alcohol drinking behavior (34% of patients), Misuses drugs (23%) and Risk activity involvement (57%). No source shows that these screenings are done in public primary care in Greece or Albania, and the rates are not local. Nothing else reads its scores or findings.
